select t.advance_registration_id from t_task_in t where t.del_flag = '0' and t.id in
#{id}

select a.id , a.advance_registration_id , a.material_id , a.actual_count , a.tray_id , a.batch_code, a.status , a.location_id , a.tray_id , b.detection_count as detectionCountDelivery, b.putaway_count as putawayCountDelivery, b.receive_count as receiveCountDelivery, b.produced_date, b.expire_date, c.id as originId, c.code as originCode, d.area_id from t_task_in a left join t_advance_delivery_detail b on a.advance_registration_id = b.id left join t_advance_delivery c on b.advance_delivery_id = c.id left join t_location d on a.location_id = d.id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.id in
#{id}

select a.id , a.advance_registration_id , a.material_id , a.predict_count , a.actual_count , a.tray_id , a.batch_code, b.code as materialCode , b.name as materialName, c.name as unitName, tt.code as trayCode from t_task_in a left join t_material b on a.material_id = b.id left join t_unit c on b.unit_id = c.id left join t_tray tt on a.tray_id = tt.id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.advance_registration_id = #{registrationId}
select ifnull(sum(current_count - before_count),0) from t_stock_detail where del_flag = '0' and type = '1' and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(now(),'%Y-%m-%d')

select ifnull(sum((t1.current_count-t1.before_count) * t2.unit_price),0) from t_stock_detail t1 left join t_material t2 on t1.material_id = t2.id where t1.del_flag = '0' and t1.type = '1' and date_format(t1.create_time,'%Y-%m') = date_format(now(),'%Y-%m')

select ifnull(sum((t1.current_count - t1.before_count) * t2.unit_price), 0) as inAmount, ifnull(sum(t1.current_count - t1.before_count), 0) as inActualCount, t2.id as materialId, t2.name as materialName from t_stock_detail t1 left join t_material t2 on t1.material_id = t2.id where t1.del_flag = '0' and t1.type = '1' and t2.important_status = '1' and date_format(t1.create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(now(), '%Y-%m') group by t2.id,t2.name
